requirements.text: Amend ADR-009 to state that host decisions (which sed -i or stat form to use) come from a probe of the tools themselves, made once when the library loads, never from a platform name
The amendment to ADR-009 names its enforcing tests inline
If zbuild_sed_inplace is renamed, amend ADR-020 to name that function as the deferred tracker's log-update helper
zbuild_sed_inplace picks its sed -i form from a probe run once when the file loads, not from a platform name
_zb_target_mode_v picks its stat form from a probe run once when the file loads, not from a platform name
With ZBUILD_PLATFORM set to a wrong value (e.g. ios), both functions still work on the host
No extra process per atomic_write; the ADR-065 process budget test (tests/e2e/fork-budget-test.sh) must still pass
Use the GNU form first (stat -c before stat -f)
The probe replaces _zb_target_mode_v's second stat call so each mode check runs one stat
